Lemma
[Cauchy's inequality with $\epsilon $] ↗ lem:cauchys-inequality 1. appB:B.2-b\group Elementary Inequalities

For $a,b>0$ and $\epsilon >0$, \[ (5)\qquad ab\leq \epsilon a^2+\frac{b^2}{4\epsilon }. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply (4) to $(2\epsilon )^{1/2}a$ and $b/(2\epsilon )^{1/2}$.

□
